event_summary: A blue cylindrical object and a yellow ball move toward each other on a tabletop, become adjacent near the center, then separate and come to rest in different areas.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a light wood-grain tabletop, a yellow-green background, and two partially visible black cylindrical fixtures at the left and right edges. After a period with no moving objects visible, a small blue cylindrical object appears from the left side while a yellow ball appears from the right side. The blue object moves rightward and the yellow ball moves leftward until they become very close near the central area. Immediately afterward, the blue object moves back toward the left side, while the yellow ball moves toward the upper-right area. Both objects slow and remain still near the end of the video.

reasons: The tabletop and side fixtures are visible in the first frame.
The two later-moving colored objects are not visible in the first frame.
The side fixtures are partially cropped by the frame edges.
